Obtained in a previous call to the BluetoothFindFirstDevice function. ## -returns Returns TRUE when the handle is successfully closed. Returns FALSE upon error. Call the GetLastError function for more information on the failure. ## -see-also BLUETOOTH_DEVICE_INFO BLUETOOTH_DEVICE_SEARCH_PARAMS BluetoothDisplayDeviceProperties BluetoothFindFirstDevice BluetoothFindNextDevice BluetoothGetDeviceInfo BluetoothRemoveDevice BluetoothUpdateDeviceRecord
